title: ResourceRequirements
description: Declares compute resources required by an application for scheduling decisions.

min.description: Total resources the application needs at once. Becomes the cluster space's quota, so it must cover every container's limits simultaneously.

maxPod.description: The heaviest single pod the application schedules. The cloud uses it to pick a node and as the LimitRange max of the space. Omitted, it falls back to `min` — which forces a node as large as the whole quota.

KubernetesQuantity.description: A quantity in Kubernetes resource format (e.g., '2', '500m', '4Gi').

MaxPodResourceSet.description: CPU and memory of the heaviest single pod. No `storage`: a volume is claimed by the space, not by a pod, so `min.storage` is already the only figure that matters.

cpu.description: CPU of the heaviest pod. Must not exceed `min.cpu`.

memory.description: Memory of the heaviest pod. Must not exceed `min.memory`.

GpuRequirements.description: GPU requirements. Each `types` entry is an nvidia-smi Product Name and is matched exactly. When `required` is true, `types` must list at least one product. The marketplace reserves a GPU only from deploy parameters whose ids are `gpuEnabled`, `gpuCount`, and `gpuModel`.

required.description: Whether a GPU is mandatory for this application.

types.description: Acceptable nvidia-smi Product Name values, most preferred first. Example: NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB.
